sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed audio stopping after repeated download interruptions. Playback recovers without restarting the song and preserves its paused state.

title: Fullscreen, artist pages, and smarter mixes

sections.title: New
items: Fullscreen player hides its controls and cursor after 3 seconds of no input, shows an up next card near the end of a song, pulses with bass hits, and keeps the screen awake. Two Appearance settings turn off the idle hide and the pulse.
Artist pages have a redesigned top with a credit row (genre, origin, subscribers, active since) and an optional muted music video behind it. Turn it on in Settings > Appearance > Artist pages.
Continuous queue style lists played songs above the current song.
Songs and albums with several artists show all of them.
A Release notes window with search, New marks, and a prompt after an update.
The progress bar fills with the next song's accent dots while a mix plays.
Canopy has a vertical volume popup, and the error pill stays above the player bar.

sections.title: Mixing and sound
items: Adaptive mix matches blends at each section's tempo for songs that change tempo.
Blends that only work behind a filter and R&B pairs that cannot blend cleanly play out at their natural boundary.
Best Mix sees these blends when it scores a queue.
Qobuz FLAC streams start and seek faster.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Mouse wheel scrolling is faster and consistent on every page.
Large playlists load with fewer UI updates and keep the scroll position.
Artwork corners are rounded in one shader pass without offscreen layers.
The account button shows only the avatar.
Music video search runs as a guest so plays stay out of YouTube search history.
The installer saves app output from first runs and shows an error when a new version fails to start.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Discord crashing on startup when a pending artist lookup was cancelled.
Fixed uploaded songs not playing because their c.youtube.com stream host was rejected.
Fixed Windows adaptive mix missing the DXC libraries it needs.
